capabilities: Convert pasted LLM math delimiters to $...$ and $$...$$
Promote shallow chat headings to proper Markdown levels
Strip citation markers and copy-button junk from chat output
Recover Markdown tables and task lists from chat HTML
Convert Note: paragraphs into Obsidian callouts
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states code blocks, inline code and math are protected from conversion.
problem: Pasting AI chat output into a note leaves broken math delimiters, shallow headings, citation noise like 【20†L33-L40】 and HTML-only tables that need manual cleanup.
summary: Auto-converts pasted ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini output into clean Obsidian Markdown: math delimiters, headings, tables, citations and callouts.
